notes.title: Bug fix in Cards 41 & 42 (Quicksand)
notes.content:
- Bug fix: Cards 41 & 42 (Quicksand) first effect was unavailable when second effect was available.
- Translation correction.

notes.title: New features requested by the community
notes.content:
New features requested by the community:
- Added option to show/hide game restore preview.
- Added option to automatically confirm messages about acquired resources.
- Only the better effect is shown when the player has to choose the effect of a given card.
- Added highlight animation of the card green checkmark (card activation button).
- Application now prevents device from entering the sleep mode during the game.
